Game Overview

In Super Ziggo, the core idea is straightforward: embark on an exhilarating adventure with Ziggo, the courageous alien, in Super Ziggo. Navigate 15 vibrant levels, defeat crafty enemies, and uncover hidden gems. Master double jumps and jetpacks to soar across intriguing landscapes. Collect treasures and power up to become the galaxies' supreme adventurer!
